recipe: sources/puredarwin-baseline/nix/pkgs/toolchain/kc-arm64.nix passes -kext PDSerialHID.kext. nix/arm64.nix kextsArm64Build installs PDSerialHID.kext. The M1 bringup and display selections symlink every generic kext except the replaced platform expert and, for display, IOGOPFramebuffer, so they do not drop PDSerialHID.
built_member_list: reports/sprint-010/kc-build.json records 50 members and does not name them. This inspection did not open that KC. Sprint-009 kc-build receipts named org.puredarwin.driver.PDSerialHID for those earlier collections.

kext.personality: IOProviderClass IOResources, IOResourceMatch IOKit, OSBundleRequired Console
kext.start: handleStart sets HIDDefaultBehavior and calls pd_serial_line_register. The log line is PDSerialHID: listening for SOH lines on the serial console.

serial_path.filter: osfmk/console/serial_general.c pd_serial_line_filter is static. A byte 0x01 starts a line. Newline delivers the line to the registered handler and does not call cons_cinput. serial_keyboard_poll is the caller.
serial_path.lines: PDSerialHID::lineHandler accepts m X Y BUTTONS and k MODS K1 K2 K3 K4 K5 K6, decimal. m sends report id 2: buttons in the low 3 bits and absolute X/Y as little-endian UInt16 capped at 0x7fff. k sends report id 1: a boot keyboard, modifiers plus six usages.
serial_path.descriptor: The report descriptor is a boot keyboard plus an absolute pointer, the shape of QEMU usb-tablet, ranges 0..32767.
serial_path.not_the_device_packet: These HID reports are not the /dev/usb_hid_kbd 8-byte or /dev/usb_hid_mouse 12-byte records. IOHIDEventService turns reports into those device packets. The ABI receipt's packet layout stays exact.

other_input_kexts.PDGadgetACM: Calls pd_serial_line_feed. That function has no definition in this tree. The SOH filter that exists is the static pd_serial_line_filter in serial_general.c.
